name: Comfort car
short: A quiet, air-conditioned saloon for two, with room for a third.
summary: A quiet, air-conditioned saloon for couples and small parties, from a single airport run to two weeks on the road.
suits: A day trip from Galle or Kandy

features.title: Comfortable on long days
features.body: Reclining rear seats and steady air conditioning, so a four-hour drive to the hill country still leaves you ready for the afternoon.

features.title: Easy in the old towns
features.body: Small enough for the narrow lanes inside Galle Fort and the streets around Kandy lake, where a van has to stop outside.

features.title: The same driver throughout
features.body: On a multi-day hire your driver stays with you, knows the plan, and is a phone call away in the evening.

included: Driver's meals and rooms on multi-day hires

questions.q: Is a car enough for a two-week journey?
questions.a: For two people with normal luggage, yes. If you travel with golf clubs, surfboards or a lot of shopping, the premium SUV or the van gives you more room.

questions.q: Can we book just an airport transfer?
questions.a: Yes. Tell us your flight number and where you are staying, and we confirm a fixed price for the transfer.
